%1$d proxies pinned on top of Telegram's proxy list. The rest keep Telegram's order.
column2: %1$d Proxys sind oben in Telegrams Proxy-Liste angeheftet. Der Rest behält Telegrams Reihenfolge.

column1: # context: Name shown in the Proxy order editor for a proxy whose address couldn't be read
Proxy
# context: Button that closes the Proxy order editor; every change was already kept
Done
# context: Button in the Proxy order editor that drops the person's own order, keeping only pins, so the rest go back to Telegram's speed order
Sort by speed
# context: Short toast after Sort by speed, at most two short lines
Unpinned proxies sort by speed again.
column2: Der Rest ist wieder nach Tempo sortiert.

column1: # context: Short toast when the proxy order couldn't be saved, at most two short lines
Couldn't save the order. Try again.
column2: Reihenfolge nicht gespeichert. Versuch es noch mal.

column1: # context: Note in the Proxy order editor when Telegram has no saved proxies. Find free proxies is a row on the same page
Telegram's proxy list is empty. Add a proxy in Telegram's proxy settings, or find free proxies, then come back here.
column2: Telegrams Proxy-Liste ist leer. Füge in Telegrams Proxy-Einstellungen einen Proxy hinzu oder suche kostenlose Proxys und komm dann hierher zurück.

column1: # context: Note at the top of the Proxy order editor. Each proxy has a handle (three short lines) to drag it by and a Pin button
Drag a proxy by its handle to move it, and pin the ones you want on top. Telegram's proxy screen shows them in this order. Once you've moved one, proxies added later go below in Telegram's order.
column2: Zieh einen Proxy an seinem Griff, um ihn zu verschieben, und hefte die oben an, die du oben haben willst. Telegrams Proxy-Bildschirm zeigt sie in dieser Reihenfolge. Sobald du einen verschoben hast, kommen später hinzugefügte Proxys darunter in Telegrams Reihenfolge.

column1: # context: Screen reader action on a proxy in the Proxy order editor that moves it one place up
Move up
# context: Screen reader action on a proxy in the Proxy order editor that moves it one place down
Move down
# context: Button on a proxy in the Proxy order editor that keeps it at the top of Telegram's proxy list
Pin
# context: Button on a pinned proxy in the Proxy order editor that lets it go back among the others
Unpin
# context: Short toast after a proxy is pinned in the Proxy order editor
Pinned on top.
# context: Short toast after a proxy is unpinned in the Proxy order editor
Unpinned.
# context: State line under a proxy in the Proxy order editor: it's pinned and Telegram connects through it now
Pinned, in use
# context: State line under a pinned proxy in the Proxy order editor
Pinned
# context: State line under the proxy Telegram connects through now, in the Proxy order editor
In use
# context: Title of the My messages row on the Conversations page (#71), and the item it adds to a group's menu at the top (the three dots), which searches the group for the messages the person sent
My messages
# context: Summary of the My messages row on the Conversations page. My messages is the name of the item it adds
A group's menu at the top gets My messages, which shows the messages you sent there in the chat's search.
column2: Das Menü oben in einer Gruppe bekommt Meine Nachrichten, das deine dort gesendeten Nachrichten in der Chatsuche zeigt.

column1: # context: Short toast when My messages couldn't open the chat's search on the person's messages, at most two short lines
Couldn't open your messages here.
column2: Deine Nachrichten ließen sich hier nicht öffnen.

column1: # context: Title of the Text direction row on the Conversations page (#71), which adds Right to left, Left to right and Control character to the text selection menu of the message box
Text direction

# context: Summary of the Text direction row on the Conversations page. Right to left, Left to right and Control character are the names of the items it adds to the message box's text selection menu; RLM and ZWJ stay as they are
The message box's text menu gets Right to left and Left to right for the lines you selected, and Control character for invisible marks like RLM or ZWJ.
column2: Das Textmenü im Nachrichtenfeld bekommt Rechts nach links und Links nach rechts für die markierten Zeilen sowie Steuerzeichen für unsichtbare Zeichen wie RLM oder ZWJ.

column1: # context: Item in the message box's text selection menu, next to Telegram's Bold and Italic, that makes the selected lines read from right to left
Right to left
# context: Item in the message box's text selection menu, next to Telegram's Bold and Italic, that makes the selected lines read from left to right
Left to right
# context: Item in the message box's text selection menu that opens a list of invisible Unicode control characters, and the title of that list
Control character
# context: Short toast when Text direction couldn't change the message box's text, at most two short lines
Couldn't change the text.
column2: Der Text ließ sich nicht ändern.

column1: # context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Left-to-right mark

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Right-to-left mark

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Zero width joiner

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Zero width non-joiner

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Zero width space

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Start of left-to-right embedding
column2: Beginn einer Einbettung von links nach rechts

column1: # context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Start of right-to-left embedding
column2: Beginn einer Einbettung von rechts nach links

column1: # context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Start of left-to-right override
column2: Beginn einer Überschreibung von links nach rechts

column1: # context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Start of right-to-left override
column2: Beginn einer Überschreibung von rechts nach links

column1: # context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Pop directional formatting

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Left-to-right isolate

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Right-to-left isolate

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
First strong isolate

# context: Name of an invisible Unicode control character in the Text direction feature's Control character list, shown after its short code (for example LRM). Keep it close to the character's Unicode name
Pop directional isolate
# context: Item in a message's long-press menu that takes the message out of the chat on this phone only. Nothing is sent, and everyone else still sees it
Hide for me
# context: Short toast right after Hide for me took a message out of the chat, at most two short lines
Hidden on this phone.
# context: Short toast after tapping Show hidden messages when nothing was hidden, at most two short lines
No messages are hidden.
# context: Short toast after tapping Show hidden messages, with how many hidden messages will show again. At most two short lines
%1$d message shows again.
%1$d messages show again.
# context: Title of the switch on the Conversations page that adds Hide for me to a message's long-press menu
Add Hide for me to the message menu
column2: Für mich ausblenden zum Nachrichtenmenü hinzufügen

column1: # context: Summary of the Add Hide for me to the message menu switch. Hide for me is the menu item's name
Adds Hide for me to a message. It leaves the chat on this phone only, with nothing sent to Telegram, so everyone else still sees it. Turn this off and hidden messages show again.
column2: Fügt einer Nachricht Für mich ausblenden hinzu. Sie verschwindet nur auf diesem Handy aus dem Chat, ohne dass etwas an Telegram geht, alle anderen sehen sie also weiter. Schalte das aus und ausgeblendete Nachrichten erscheinen wieder.

column1: # context: Title of the row on the Conversations page that brings back every message hidden with Hide for me
Show hidden messages
# context: Summary of the Show hidden messages row. Hide for me is the message menu item's name
Brings back every message you hid with Hide for me, in every account. Open the chat again to see them.
column2: Holt jede Nachricht zurück, die du mit Für mich ausblenden versteckt hast, in jedem Konto. Öffne den Chat erneut, um sie zu sehen.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names Hide for me in the message menu
hiding messages for you
column2: das Ausblenden von Nachrichten nur für dich

column1: # context: Item in a message's long-press menu, and the title of the chat picker it opens. It sends the message's text to the picked chat as a new message, with no formatting
Forward as plain text
# context: Title of the switch on the Conversations page that adds Forward as plain text to a message's long-press menu
Add Forward as plain text to the message menu
column2: Als reinen Text weiterleiten zum Nachrichtenmenü hinzufügen

column1: # context: Summary of the Add Forward as plain text to the message menu switch. Forward as plain text is the menu item's name. Custom emoji are Telegram's Premium emoji. Regular ones are the phone's own emoji
Adds Forward as plain text to a message you can forward. Pick a chat and its text is sent there as a new message, with no formatting or sender name. Custom emoji become regular ones.
column2: Fügt Als reinen Text weiterleiten zu einer Nachricht hinzu, die du weiterleiten kannst. Wähle einen Chat, und ihr Text wird dort als neue Nachricht gesendet, ohne Formatierung und ohne Absendernamen. Eigene Emojis werden zu normalen.

column1: # context: Item in the long-press menu of your own message. It deletes the message for everyone else in the chat and keeps it on this phone
Delete for them
# context: Title of the switch on the Conversations page that adds Delete for them to the long-press menu of your own messages
Add Delete for them to the message menu
column2: Für andere löschen zum Nachrichtenmenü hinzufügen

column1: # context: Summary of the Add Delete for them to the message menu switch. Delete for them is the menu item's name. Marked deleted means the word deleted next to the message's time. Clear kept messages is the name of a row in settings
Adds Delete for them to your own messages in chats and groups. It deletes the message for everyone else and keeps it on this phone, marked deleted. Clear kept messages removes it here too.
column2: Fügt Für andere löschen zu deinen eigenen Nachrichten in Chats und Gruppen hinzu. Die Nachricht wird für alle anderen gelöscht und bleibt auf diesem Handy, als gelöscht markiert. Behaltene Nachrichten löschen entfernt sie auch hier.

column1: # context: Short message shown after Delete for them: the message is gone for everyone else in the chat and stays on this phone
Deleted for them, kept here.
# context: Item in the music player's menu (the three dots, #71) that opens the song's lyrics over the player
Lyrics
# context: Line in the lyrics panel while the song's lyrics load
Looking for the lyrics.
# context: Line in the lyrics panel when the lyrics couldn't be loaded. Tapping the line tries again
Couldn't load the lyrics. Tap to try again.
column2: Songtext konnte nicht geladen werden. Tippe, um es erneut zu versuchen.

column1: # context: Line in the lyrics panel when the lyrics library has nothing for the song playing
No lyrics found for this song.
column2: Kein Songtext für diesen Song gefunden.

column1: # context: Line in the lyrics panel when the lyrics library lists the song as having no words
This song is instrumental.
# context: Small credit line at the bottom of the lyrics panel. lrclib.net is the website's name and stays as it is
Lyrics from lrclib.net
# context: Title of the switch on the Playback page (#71) that adds Lyrics to the music player's menu
Lyrics in the music player
# context: Summary of the Lyrics in the music player switch. Lyrics is the name of the menu item it adds; lrclib.net stays as it is. Timed lyrics are ones that know when each line is sung
The music player's menu gets Lyrics. They come from lrclib.net, and timed ones follow along with the song.
column2: Das Menü des Musikplayers bekommt Songtext. Die Texte kommen von lrclib.net, und zeitgesteuerte laufen mit dem Song mit.

column1: # context: Title of the switch on the Playback page (#71) that shows the day each song was added to your profile's song list
Dates on your profile songs
# context: Summary of the Dates on your profile songs switch. The day is shown after the song's artist in your profile's song list
Songs you add to your profile from now on show the day you added them, after the artist. The days are kept on this phone only.
column2: Songs, die du ab jetzt zu deinem Profil hinzufügst, zeigen nach dem Interpreten den Tag, an dem du sie hinzugefügt hast. Die Daten bleiben nur auf diesem Handy.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase naming Dates on your profile songs (#71) in the patch status list
dates on your profile songs
# context: Item at the end of the menu under a chat's preview (press and hold a chat, #71) that opens the previewed chat fully
Open chat
# context: Item at the end of the menu under a chat's preview (press and hold a chat, #71) that closes the preview
Close preview
# context: Title of the switch on the Chat list page (#71) that adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat's preview
Buttons in chat previews
# context: Summary of the Buttons in chat previews switch. Open chat and Close preview are the names of the two menu items it adds
Pressing and holding a chat adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under its preview.
column2: Wenn du einen Chat gedrückt hältst, bekommt das Menü unter seiner Vorschau „Chat öffnen“ und „Vorschau schließen“.

column1: # context: Title of a switch under Add Repeat to the message menu (#71). Turned on, the bar that shows while messages are selected gets a Screenshot button that saves a picture of them.
Screenshot selected messages
# context: Summary of the Screenshot selected messages switch. Screenshot is the button's own label. Pictures/Telegram is a folder name on the phone, keep it as it is.
Adds a Screenshot button to the bar that shows while you pick messages. It saves a picture of them as the chat shows them, background, dates and times included, to Pictures/Telegram.
column2: Fügt der Leiste, die beim Auswählen von Nachrichten erscheint, eine Schaltfläche Screenshot hinzu. Sie speichert ein Bild der Nachrichten so, wie der Chat sie zeigt, mit Hintergrund, Datum und Uhrzeit, unter Pictures/Telegram.

column1: # context: Label of the button in the bar that shows while messages are selected (#71). Tapping it saves a picture of the selected messages.
Screenshot
# context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the Screenshot button for selected messages.
screenshots of selected messages
# context: Toast from the Screenshot button when a selected message isn't on screen, so it can't be pictured. Two short lines at most.
Scroll so they're all on screen
column2: Scrolle, bis alle zu sehen sind

column1: # context: Toast from the Screenshot button in a secret chat, where it never takes a picture. Two short lines at most.
Not in secret chats
# context: Toast from the Screenshot button in a chat whose owner turned off saving and copying. Two short lines at most.
This chat doesn't allow saving
# context: Toast once the Screenshot button's picture is saved. Pictures is the phone's pictures folder. Two short lines at most.
Screenshot saved to Pictures
